Chan claims a full solution of the freeness conjecture via analytic adjoint ideal sheaves; withdrawn after Helmke found a flaw on p.31
events.credibility_reason: Withdrawn after Helmke identified that the construction of a local holomorphic section fails to preserve the required vanishing order under extension.

events.what: Han claims a linear bound m ≥ ⌈1.776n⌉ for Fujita's freeness conjecture

judgement.doubts: Agree with the record's codes. The bullet covers both freeness and very-ampleness, so even Chan's claim would only have been a case; it is knocked down regardless. The record's summary wrongly says the bound 'moved twice' — the withdrawn Chan claim moved nothing. Han's bound is four weeks old and unreviewed; only a Michigan seminar presentation is noted.
